title: Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Explainable Fault Detection for Fixed-Wing UAVs: code and results
description: MATLAB and Python code and results for a leakage audit of the ALFA fixed-wing UAV dataset and a leave-one-flight-out, nested evaluation of physics-informed residual features, a bagged-tree fault detection and isolation model and a held-out SHAP audit.
